activity_summary: You entered ten shillings in the received column, dated the fifth of July 1595. You did not write a balance. The old sum stays whatever it was the last time you counted, and you do not count it tonight.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the received line and left the balance blank.

entities.name: 10s received
entities.context: Mentioned in Received, and no total
